paragraphs:
I’m a Product Designer based in Berlin, working mostly on fintech and B2B SaaS products, with a background in architecture and UX research.

Architecture taught me to think in systems and design with implementation in mind. Research taught me to understand people’s needs before jumping to solutions. Together, they shape how I approach complex product problems.

Today, I work from discovery through to detailed design, partnering with product managers and engineers to turn user insights and business goals into clear, intuitive experiences.

timeline.heading: How I got here
timeline.subtitle: A path through architecture, content, research and product design.

entries.description: Led end-to-end product design across 10+ fintech partner apps, from discovery and prototyping to usability testing, design systems, and implementation.
Combined user research, behavioural data, and support insights to identify banking self-service barriers and inform product and content improvements.
Improved product discovery through research-driven navigation and filtering, contributing to a 10% average increase in purchase conversion on affected pages.
Designed digital products and interfaces for startups and small businesses, covering UX research, audits, prototyping, and developer handoff.
Progressed from content strategy to leading regional content specialists, shaping product messaging, onboarding, and content guidelines with cross-functional teams.
Contributed to research, concept design, prototyping, and documentation across commercial, residential, and mixed-use architectural projects.

items.name: Joe Cummins
items.title: UX/UI & Creative Design
items.text: Working as a designer under Moises's lead at AAZZUR is a pleasure. He has an incredibly efficient and streamlined approach to design and logistics. He is also a dedicated worker, which is reflected in his expertise and breadth of knowledge. Not only is Moises an exemplary lead designer, but mentoring his team also comes naturally to him. I'd gladly recommend Moises as an invaluable member of any team he joins.

items.name: Filip Schwarz
items.title: Growth Designer
items.text: I had the pleasure of working with Moises in Ladenzeile. As a talented UX Designer, he played a pivotal role in reducing bounce rates, increasing conversion rates, and optimizing navigation. His data-driven approach and collaborative mindset were invaluable. While we no longer work together, I highly recommend Moises as an excellent Designer and Researcher with a strong focus on enhancing user experiences.

items.name: Manuel Astorga Santana
items.title: Art Director & UX/UI, Visual & Digital Designer
items.text: I had the opportunity to collaborate with Moises, and it was always a great experience. We supported each other on various design projects, and he was someone I could always count on for help and honest feedback. We frequently bounced ideas off one another, shared insights, and encouraged each other's growth as designers. Moises brings a thoughtful and collaborative approach to everything he does, which made working with him both productive and enjoyable.

items.name: Hande Yildirim
items.title: Visual Designer
items.text: Moises is an incredible mentor! His guidance and insights were invaluable, and he truly cares about helping others succeed. He shares clear, actionable insights and provides thoughtful guidance tailored to your goals. I highly recommend him to anyone seeking thoughtful and impactful mentorship.

items.name: Silva Karar
items.title: Freelancer Designer
items.text: Moises is a wonderful mentor. He is very knowledgeable about UX design and shared many actionable insights. I highly recommend anyone looking for a great mentor to book a session with Moises.
